bytedance / seedance-2-5-flash
Commercial usePart of the ByteDance API family — compare all ByteDance models →

Seedance 2.5 Flash is the Flash tier of ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video family, released on November 12, 2026. It uses the same fields as Seedance 2.5 and generates 480p or 720p video of 4 to 30 seconds with native audio from a text prompt, a first frame, first and last frames, or up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips.

Pricing: 480P: 11.5 credits/s ($0.0575/s, with video) | 18.5 credits/s ($0.0925/s, no video) 720P: 25.5 credits/s ($0.1275/s, with video) | 41 credits/s ($0.205/s, no video) 🔸Note🔸: Video input has a lower per-second rate because both input and output durations are billed. - With video input: Rate × (Total uploaded video duration + Generated video duration) - Without video input (text/images only): Rate × Generated video duration High-tier top-ups come with bonus credits that lower the effective price by about 10%. Prices are currently in beta and may be adjusted in the future.

README

Complete guide to using bytedance/seedance-2-5-flash

Seedance 2.5 Flash API for 480p and 720p Video with Native Audio

Generate clips of 4 to 30 seconds from text, a first frame, first and last frames, or multimodal references, with ambient sound, sound effects and music generated in the same pass.

Key Capabilities of Seedance 2.5 Flash

Seedance 2.5 Flash covers text to video, image to video and multimodal reference video in one model, with the same fields as Seedance 2.5.
01

The Flash Tier of Seedance 2.5

ByteDance describes Seedance 2.5 Flash as producing results close to those of its flagship Seedance 2.5. It uses the same fields as Seedance 2.5 and outputs 480p or 720p, which suits high-volume generation and quick iteration.
02

Text to Video up to 30 Seconds

Describe a scene and get one continuous clip of 4 to 30 seconds, or set duration to -1 and let the model choose the length. Output is 480p or 720p in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9 or adaptive.
03

First Frame and First-and-Last-Frame Control

Start a video from a single image, or give a first frame and a last frame so the video ends exactly on the last frame. With frame inputs the aspect ratio is adaptive and follows the image. This works well for product animations and shots that must connect to the next scene.
04

Multimodal References: Up to 10 Images, 5 Videos, 5 Audio Clips

Combine up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips in one request and give each one a role in the prompt, such as @Image1 for the character, @Video1 for the camera motion and @Audio1 for the music. References keep characters, products and style consistent across shots. Each reference video or audio clip runs 2 to 30 seconds, with no more than 30 seconds of video and 30 seconds of audio in total.
05

Native Audio in the Same Pass

Ambient sound, sound effects and music are generated together with the picture, so a clip arrives with its soundtrack. Set generate_audio to false when you only need silent footage.
06

Video from a Music Track and a Prompt

Seedance 2.5 Flash also accepts a prompt with only an audio reference, without any image or video. Give it a music track and a description of the scene, and it generates visuals that match the music.

Seedance 2.5 Flash API Parameters

Inputs and options of the bytedance/seedance-2-5-flash request. The generation mode follows the inputs: a first frame means image to video, references mean multimodal reference video, and text alone means text to video.

ParameterValues
modelbytedance/seedance-2-5-flash
promptUp to 20,480 characters; required for text to video and multimodal reference
first_frame_url, last_frame_urlImage URLs (JPG, PNG, WEBP); a last frame needs a first frame; cannot be combined with references
reference_image_urlsUp to 10 images (JPG, PNG, WEBP)
reference_video_urlsUp to 5 videos (MP4, MOV) of 2 to 30 seconds each, no more than 30 seconds in total; 480p to 720p
reference_audio_urlsUp to 5 audio clips (MP3, WAV) of 2 to 30 seconds each, no more than 30 seconds in total
resolution480p, 720p
aspect_ratio1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, 21:9, adaptive (default); frame inputs use adaptive
duration4 to 30 seconds, or -1 for automatic; default 5
generate_audiotrue (default) or false
output_formatmp4 (default) or mov
return_last_frameAlso returns the last frame as an image; default false
web_searchText to video only; default false

Seedance 2.5 Flash vs Seedance 2.5

Both models use the same fields. Use Seedance 2.5 for 1080p, draft previews or more references; use Seedance 2.5 Flash for 480p or 720p, high-volume generation and quick iteration.

FeatureSeedance 2.5 FlashSeedance 2.5
Resolution480p, 720p480p, 720p, 1080p
Draft modeNoYes
References per requestUp to 10 images, 5 videos, 5 audio clipsUp to 30 images, 10 videos, 10 audio clips
Prompt with only an audio referenceSupportedNot supported
Native audio, frame inputs, 4 to 30 seconds, seven aspect ratiosYesYes

How to Prompt Seedance 2.5 Flash

A four-step workflow from first draft to approved shot.
  1. 1

    Step 1: Describe the Shot

    Describe the subject, the action, the camera movement, the lighting and the sound you want, such as ambience, effects or music.
  2. 2

    Step 2: Choose Your Inputs

    Use text alone, a first frame, a first and last frame, or reference images, videos and audio. Give each reference a role in the prompt, for example @Image1 for the character and @Audio1 for the music.
  3. 3

    Step 3: Set Resolution, Length and Ratio

    Choose 480p or 720p and a duration from 4 to 30 seconds, or -1 for automatic. For text or reference requests, pick an aspect ratio such as 9:16 for vertical feeds; frame inputs use adaptive and follow the image.
  4. 4

    Step 4: Iterate, Then Finalize

    Compare a few variations and pick a direction. If you need 1080p output, generate a new version with Seedance 2.5 from the same prompt and references.

What You Can Build with Seedance 2.5 Flash

Typical uses for 480p and 720p video with sound.

Ad and Product Concept Drafts

Test several directions for a campaign at 720p, animate a product photo from a first frame, and pick the version worth finishing.

Social Clips of Up to 30 Seconds with Sound

Produce vertical 9:16 clips of up to 30 seconds, generated as one continuous clip with ambient sound, effects and music.

Consistent Characters and Products

Use reference images, videos and audio to keep characters, products and style consistent across a series of clips.

Music-Led Visuals

Start from a music track and a short description to generate visuals that match the music, or combine the track with character and setting references.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Seedance 2.5 Flash?

Seedance 2.5 Flash is the Flash tier of ByteDance's Seedance 2.5 video model family, released on November 12, 2026. It generates 480p or 720p video of 4 to 30 seconds with native audio from text, images, video and audio inputs.

How is Seedance 2.5 Flash different from Seedance 2.5?

Both models use the same fields. Seedance 2.5 Flash outputs 480p or 720p, has no draft mode and takes up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips per request. Seedance 2.5 adds 1080p and a draft mode and takes up to 30 images, 10 videos and 10 audio clips.

Does Seedance 2.5 Flash support 1080p or 4K?

No. Seedance 2.5 Flash outputs 480p or 720p. For 1080p output, use Seedance 2.5.

How long can a Seedance 2.5 Flash video be?

Each generation is one continuous clip of 4 to 30 seconds. Set duration to -1 to let the model choose the length.

Does Seedance 2.5 Flash generate audio?

Yes. Ambient sound, sound effects and music are generated together with the video by default. Set generate_audio to false for silent clips.

How many reference files can Seedance 2.5 Flash use?

Up to 10 images, 5 videos and 5 audio clips per request. Each reference video or audio clip can be 2 to 30 seconds long, with no more than 30 seconds of video and 30 seconds of audio in total. Reference videos should be between 480p and 720p; a 640×360 clip is too small.

Can Seedance 2.5 Flash generate a video from only an audio reference?

Yes. Seedance 2.5 Flash accepts a prompt with only an audio reference and no image or video, for example a music track and a description of the scene. Seedance 2.5 does not support this combination.

How do I call the Seedance 2.5 Flash API on Kie.ai?

Create an API key on the Kie.ai API Key Management page, then send a POST request to https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/jobs/createTask with model set to bytedance/seedance-2-5-flash and your inputs under input. The request returns a taskId: poll GET https://api.kie.ai/api/v1/jobs/recordInfo?taskId=... or set callBackUrl to receive the video URL. All parameters are in the Seedance 2.5 Flash API docs.

How is Seedance 2.5 Flash billed on Kie.ai?

Seedance 2.5 Flash is billed per second of generated video, with separate rates for 480p and 720p, and failed tasks are not charged. Requests with reference videos use a lower per-second rate applied to the reference video length plus the generated length; reference images and audio add no billable seconds. Current rates are shown on the pricing card on this page.
